limitations: Six early checks only. No module state rollback, no new effect permission, no guarded React explorer.
Explicit application import after fixture.update is not evidence of an import in the unmodified React suffix. Both orders stop without branch observations.

Saved loader callbacks and native caches remain unowned. ModuleCache.load writes its cache before its callback; composeModuleLoaders.finish may push a context before the guarded FinishLoadingImportedModule entry.
Import evaluation/coercion/allocation and earlier module work can precede guarded entry points. Failure is not rollback or universal cleanup.
Direct host calls reject without necessarily poisoning an evaluator. Failures through registered resume are terminal. Cached meta and ordinary control tests already passed the predecessor.
Initial opaque payload fixture ran but failed types (TS2353/TS2559). Final tests use actual engine-created payload; exact final source hash checked.
Test262 gate uses unchanged10secondtimeout/twoworkers; top-level globs only. Unit timeout remains5seconds. Green narrow runs do not erase earlier conformance failures.
